interactions.title: Using Place Value to Round Numbers

activity.prompt: Place 384 between its neighboring tens and hundreds.
activity.instruction: Use the place-value chart first. Then give both intervals that contain the number.
activity.correctFeedback: Correct. 384 lies between 380 and 390, and between 300 and 400.
activity.tryAgainFeedback: Look at the tens around 384 first, then the hundreds around it. Keep 384 inside both intervals.

markers: How does he record this time

activity.prompt: Round 37 minutes to the nearest ten.
activity.instruction: Find the halfway point between the two neighboring tens before choosing.
activity.correctFeedback: Correct. 37 is above 35, so it rounds to 40.
activity.tryAgainFeedback: Compare the distance from 37 to 30 with the distance from 37 to 40.
activity.strategy: 37 is between 30 and 40. The halfway number is 35. Because 37 is greater than 35, 37 rounds to 40.

markers: 236 rounded to the nearest hundred is 200

activity.instruction: The model contains 2 hundreds, 3 tens, and 6 ones. Decide whether the tens have reached the halfway point.
activity.correctFeedback: Correct. 3 tens is less than the 5-tens halfway point.
activity.tryAgainFeedback: The halfway point from 200 to 300 is 250. Locate 236 relative to 250.
activity.strategy: 236 is between 200 and 300. The halfway number is 250. Because 236 is less than 250, 236 rounds to 200.

interactions.title: Using Place Value to Round Numbers

activity.instruction: First identify the neighboring hundreds. Then use the halfway point to make the decision.
activity.correctFeedback: Correct. 879 is greater than 850 and closer to 900.
activity.tryAgainFeedback: When rounding to the nearest hundred, compare 879 with the halfway number 850.
activity.strategy: 879 is between 800 and 900. The halfway number is 850. Because 879 is greater than 850, 879 rounds to 900.

activity.prompt: Find the total number of songs represented by 147 and 212.
activity.instruction: Break apart both addends into hundreds, tens, and ones. Add matching places, then combine the partial sums.
activity.hint: Break apart both numbers into hundreds, tens, and ones. Add matching places.

activity.instruction: Add hundreds, tens, and ones. Regroup when a place has ten or more of the same unit.
activity.hint: The tens total 11 tens. Regroup 10 of those tens as 1 hundred.
activity.strategy: 130 + 280 has 0 ones, 11 tens, and 3 hundreds. Regroup 11 tens as 1 hundred and 1 ten: 410.

interactions.title: Connecting Place-Value Strategies to an Algorithm

activity.prompt: Use place value to find the sum 225 + 229.
activity.instruction: Add from ones to hundreds and record each regrouping in the next place.
activity.hint: Start with 5 ones + 9 ones. Record 4 ones and regroup 1 ten.
activity.strategy: 5 + 9 = 14, so record 4 ones and regroup 1 ten. Then 2 + 2 + 1 = 5 tens, and 2 + 2 = 4 hundreds: 454.

activity.instruction: Use the addition algorithm, beginning with the ones, and show the regrouped ten.
activity.hint: The ones make 11. Regroup 1 ten before adding the tens column.
activity.strategy: 5 + 6 = 11 ones. Regroup 1 ten; 4 + 2 + 1 = 7 tens; 3 + 6 = 9 hundreds. The sum is 971.

activity.prompt: Start with 475 beads and subtract the 134 beads used.
activity.instruction: Break apart both numbers by place value and subtract matching units.
activity.hint: Subtract ones from ones, tens from tens, and hundreds from hundreds.

markers: how many flowers are not lilies

activity.prompt: Find how many of 365 flowers are not among the 186 lilies.
activity.instruction: Regroup hundreds, tens, or ones as needed before subtracting each place.
activity.hint: Regroup once from the hundreds place and once from the tens place.
activity.strategy: Regroup 365 as 2 hundreds, 15 tens, and 15 ones. Then subtract 186 by place value to get 1 hundred, 7 tens, and 9 ones: 179.

markers: How many seeds does Malik have left

activity.prompt: Start at 137 and add on until you reach 205.
activity.instruction: Add on ones to reach the next ten, tens to reach the next hundred, and ones to reach 205. Then add the jumps.
activity.hint: Add 3 to reach 140, then 60 to reach 200, then 5 to reach 205.

interactions.title: Connecting Place-Value Strategies to an Algorithm

markers: Use place value to help you subtract
Regroup a ten into the ones place

activity.prompt: Use place value to find the difference 385 − 158.
activity.instruction: Subtract from ones to hundreds and record each regrouping before subtracting.
activity.hint: Regroup 1 ten so that 5 ones becomes 15 ones.
activity.strategy: Regroup 385 as 3 hundreds, 7 tens, and 15 ones. Then 15 − 8 = 7, 7 − 5 = 2, and 3 − 1 = 2: 227.

activity.prompt: Find 450 − 131 using a strategy you can explain.
activity.instruction: Use the subtraction algorithm, regrouping one ten as ten ones before subtracting.
activity.hint: Regroup 1 ten as 10 ones before subtracting the ones column.
activity.strategy: Regroup 450 as 4 hundreds, 4 tens, and 10 ones. Then subtract 131 by place value: 3 hundreds, 1 ten, and 9 ones = 319.
